name: PIUSHA PRIYADARSHAN ROUT
headline: Student Designer & Creative Technologist
bio:
About Me

Hi, I'm Piusha Priyadarshan Rout, a passionate and dedicated Full Stack Developer who enjoys building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.

I love turning creative ideas into practical digital solutions using modern technologies. I have an interest in both frontend and backend development, with a focus on clean code, problem-solving, and creating smooth user experiences.

I'm always eager to learn new technologies, improve my development skills, and explore exciting challenges. My goal is to build innovative, efficient, and scalable applications while growing as a developer.

Passionate about coding, creativity, and continuous learning.
availability: Available for Summer 2026 Internships & Design Engineering Roles

Authored documentation, built UI accessibility enhancements, and submitted merged PRs across modern web design toolkits and developer CLI utilities.
